{{Top}}The '''Civilian Astrogation Corps''' was a volunteer group of explorers, astrogators, and cartographers responsible for keeping hyperspace navigation charts up to date, and made wide use of [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000s]] in order to do so.
